headline: EQT to Acquire Range Resources in $50 Billion Natural Gas Deal
summary: EQT Corp. has agreed to buy Range Resources in an all-stock transaction valued at over $50 billion including debt, creating a vertically integrated U.S. natural gas producer.
why: Consolidation among major exploration and production companies alters supply dynamics and capital allocation in the U.S. energy sector.

impacts.name: EQT Corp
impacts.why: Large all-stock acquisitions create dilution for existing shareholders while increasing production scale.

impacts.name: Natural Gas
impacts.why: Consolidation concentrates production capacity among fewer large operators, potentially influencing regional gas pricing power.

why_moved: A multi-billion dollar M&A transaction alters the competitive landscape for natural gas producers and triggers heavy trading in the shares of both companies.
